correctness.rationale: The frozen decimal root prefixes were incorrect in the last displayed digits. The complete repaired RESULT.md corrects both prefixes to 2.359304085971776… and 2.573271963535193… and gives witnesses for incomparability at every allowed N. Exact rational evaluation gives opposite signs at each prefix and that prefix plus 10^-15; the q=3 cubic and comparator quartic are increasing beyond the respective brackets. The analytic result is unchanged. For N≥4 the middle-bond swap leaves all but the two exterior bonds unchanged; the signs of their net changes give the allowed triple-to-triple edges. An indexed closed walk counts a labelled word once, not a rotation class. Rebuilding the equality-pattern quotient by checking each already-used appended colour and one fresh colour with multiplicity q minus the number used gives both displayed quartics and independently reproduces the full q=3 antiferromagnetic characteristic factorization. In each full graph every triple reaches a uniform triple, all uniform triples communicate by the displayed appending paths, and coordinate reversal reverses directed paths. The resulting connected graphs have uniform self-loops and are primitive. The positive quotient eigenvector lifts, and a positive left Perron vector with a deficient row implies λ<q. At λ_A, p_F is strictly negative by the polynomial difference λ_A²(q−λ_A), so a larger positive root of p_F exists. Finally a proper cyclic colouring containing 010 has positive antiferromagnetic energy change at a window beginning with 010 and is AF-only; the two-run word with both runs of length at least two is F-only. Both witnesses exist for all N≥4.
